svg.title: Tower Defense · Spark (electricity) tower (#22) · Direction B: Cottage Dynamo
svg.text: Spark tower · Direction B: Cottage Dynamo
Tower Defense · art request #22 (3D-looking electricity tower, fantasy, cozy) · concept sheet, not final art
1 · Base tower at real in-game size (1x) and at 3x
Scene: one board cell beside the road (1x)
base · Storm II · Overload II, beside the road
Storm II · branch A, rust mark
Overload II · branch B, gold mark
Storm: chains to 5 (more rods, more arcs)
Overload: full damage every jump (bigger core)
Idea: a little timber-framed cottage with glowing blue windows and a stone coil chimney that sparks; a box with two visible walls reads as 3D.
Risk: the coziest, but it can read as a house or the keep rather than a tower, and it is wider than the others in its cell.
Storm adds a second coil on the gable with an arc between them; Overload thickens the chimney coil with gold bands and a bigger core.
